meta.name: i-have-adhd
meta.description: Shape output for a reader with ADHD: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, make wins visible. Invoke with /i-have-adhd; stays on until "stop adhd mode".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重组输出以适配多动症读者:先给动作、分步骤、限时反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让写出的说明和通知更容易被多动症同事或客户看懂
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your instructions to be clearer for colleagues or customers with ADHD.

howto.what: 开启后，Claude 的回复会先给可直接执行的动作，多步骤任务会用编号列出；每轮结束时会重述进度并给出一个两分钟内能完成的下一步，同时避免客套和跑题。
howto.when: 当你说“/i-have-adhd”时触发，之后所有回复都按此模式输出，直到你说“stop adhd mode”停止。

say.note: 启动 ADHD 友好输出模式。

say.text: 先告诉我第一步该做什么，再列步骤。
say.note: 回复会自动调整为行动优先。

say.text: 每个步骤给个时间估计，别写客套话。
say.note: 输出会带具体时间，并去掉寒暄。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude's responses lead with an actionable next step, use numbered lists for multi-step work, restate progress each turn, end with a concrete next step, and omit pleasantries and tangents.
howto.when_en: Triggered by saying "/i-have-adhd"; stays active for all replies until you say "stop adhd mode".

say_en.text: First tell me the action to take, then list the steps.
Estimate time for each step and skip pleasantries.
say_en.note: Output will include specific times and no fluff.
